task: When should we schedule maintenance on the charging stations in the Bolzano area to minimise impact on users? Propose concrete weekday/time windows backed by observed usage.
markdown:
## Answer
The best-supported maintenance slot for the Bolzano area is early morning on Thursday, 05:00-07:00 local time, with Tuesday and Friday at the same hours as fallbacks. These were the three lowest-usage 2-hour windows observed, though they reflect occupancy rather than demand [E2]. Evening windows on Wednesday, Saturday and Monday should be avoided [E2].

## Key findings
- Thu 05:00-07:00 has the lowest occupancy, 0.066 (6.6%), across 5 comparable dates [E2].
- Tue 05:00-07:00 is second at 0.124 (12.4%) over 4 comparable dates, and Fri 05:00-07:00 is third at 0.146 (14.6%) over 4 comparable dates [E2].
- The busiest windows are Wed 20:00-22:00 (0.72, 6 dates), Sat 21:00-23:00 (0.654, 5 dates) and Mon 20:00-22:00 (0.651, 4 dates) [E2].
- Weekday daytime occupancy is mostly about 0.37-0.66 between 08:00 and 19:00, against an overall Bolzano occupancy of 0.435 [E2].
- Overnight values (00:00-04:00) are often 0.0, but 44 grid cells fall below the 4-date minimum and many are null, so this evidence is weak [E2].
- Weekend overnight readings are inconsistent: Sat 00:00-04:00 reads 0.691, 0.301, 0.821 and 0.0 [E2].
- BZ_BOEHLER_01 is a single-point site with occupancy 0.57, full_time 0.57 and peak local hour 5, so the 05:00-07:00 window suits it poorly [E3].
- BZ_C_RISPARMIO_01 (0.669, full_time 0.462) and BZ_P_VITTORIA (0.635, full_time 0.277) both peak at hour 8, so work there should finish before 08:00 [E3].

## Recommendation
- Schedule routine Bolzano-wide maintenance on Thursday 05:00-07:00. Use Tuesday or Friday 05:00-07:00 if more time or a second slot is needed [E2].
- Do not schedule work in the Wed 20:00-22:00, Sat 21:00-23:00 or Mon 20:00-22:00 windows [E2].
- Treat BZ_BOEHLER_01 separately. Its peak hour is 5, so choose another time after checking its hourly profile, which is not in the evidence here [E3].
- Complete work at BZ_C_RISPARMIO_01 and BZ_P_VITTORIA before 08:00 [E3].
- Overnight slots may be quieter, but confirm them with more data before relying on them [E2].

## Limitations & unknowns
- The data show occupancy only, not faults, energy, official sessions or demand, so quiet windows are not proven low-demand times [E1].
- Only 43 of 51 sites have any data in the window, and 22 sites were excluded for under 24 hours of exposure [E1, E3].
- Coverage of the top-ranked sites is low: 0.147, 0.082, 0.227, 0.044 and 0.033, with exposure of 44.44 to 305.59 hours over the 56-day window [E3].
- Comparable dates per window are only 4-5, so the ranking could shift with more data [E2].
- Hourly profiles for individual sites were unavailable, so site-specific windows cannot be proposed beyond the peak hours above.

## Sources
- [E1] dataset_overview — Open Data Hub South Tyrol EChargingPlug status, window 2026-09-19..2026-11-14
- [E2] hourly_profile(scope=bolzano) — Open Data Hub South Tyrol EChargingPlug status, window 2026-09-19..2026-11-14
- [E3] rank_sites(metric=occupancy) — Open Data Hub South Tyrol EChargingPlug status, window 2026-09-19..2026-11-14
